newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinaoil says 1996 oil export volumes down.
newsitem.headline: Chinaoil says 1996 oil export volumes down.

text.p: China National United Oil Corp (Chinaoil) will post lower volumes of crude oil exports and refined oil imports this year, although export revenues will rise due to improved prices, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper also said the company would benefit from a recent agreement between China and Venezuela on energy cooperation.

Chinaoil, a joint venture between China National Petroleum Corp and China National Chemicals Import and Export Corp, expected crude oil exports to reach 6.77 million tonnes worth $930 million to $940 million this year compared with 7.07 million tonnes worth $860 million last year, the newspaper said.
"A price rise on overseas oil markets this year resulted in the firm's revenue rise," it quoted Chinaoil president Lin Qingshan as saying.
